g.text: Uniform wall heat flux, constant-property laminar circular-tube model; developing-layer sketch is qualitative. The lower normalized profile is the
analytical fully developed solution. T_b is velocity-weighted for uniform density/c_p. Constant wall temperature is a different boundary condition.
